hot_tradeoff: Repeatedly resident selected expert weights show 20-27% down-projection regressions. A bank larger than L2 is a locality prediction, not a guarantee; end-to-end validation is still required.

CUDA/CPU cargo checks, release CLI build and all three added staging tests passed in coordinated validation.
